description: This file contains integration test cases for role management in the Apache Fineract project. It tests creating, disabling, enabling, and deleting roles, as well as verifying role deletion behavior when active users are associated. The code uses JUnit 5 for testing and RestAssured for HTTP requests.

classes.name: RolesTest
classes.description: A class containing integration tests for role management functionalities such as create, disable, enable, delete, and validation of roles in the project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured configuration and sets up request and response specifications before each test.

methods.name: testCreateRolesStatus
methods.description: Tests the creation of a role and verifies the returned role ID.

methods.name: testDisableRolesStatus
methods.description: Tests disabling a role and verifies that the role becomes disabled.

methods.name: testEnableRolesStatus
methods.description: Tests enabling a previously disabled role and verifies it is enabled.

methods.name: testDeleteRoleStatus
methods.description: Tests deleting a role and verifies the deletion.

methods.name: testRoleShouldGetDeletedIfNoActiveUserExists
methods.description: Verifies that a role with no active users can be deleted successfully.

methods.name: testRoleShouldNotGetDeletedIfActiveUserExists
methods.description: Verifies that a role with active users cannot be deleted and results in a 403 response.
